sentences.text: Dame Margaret Natalie Smith , -LRB- born 28 December 1934 -RRB- , known as Maggie Smith , is an English actress .	Dame	Dame Commander of the Order of the British Empire
She has had an extensive , varied career in stage , film and television spanning over sixty-five years .
Smith has appeared in over 50 films and is one of Britain 's most recognisable actresses .

A prominent figure in British culture for six decades , she was made a Dame by Queen Elizabeth II in 1990 for services to the performing arts , and received the Companion of Honour from the Queen in 2014 for services to drama .
